title: NFL-RevEng | Digest 09 Sep 19–24 | 7. LESSONS (builder-oriented)
body:
## 7. LESSONS (builder-oriented)


- **Composite-metric construction patterns observed in the wild:** ARBY (65% ARBY / 35% RB YPC, 65% prior-year / 35% current-year, 50/50 offense-defense; TNF version adds game-weighting 5/2 across windows); benbbaldwin pass-protection composite (PFF 40% / SIS blown-block 40% / ESPN PBWR 20%, each source re-scaled 0–100 before blending); SamHoppen Week 3 composite power ratings (mean of 6 sources as expected spread vs. average, with per-team std dev as the disagreement measure); ThunderDan PROJ YPPR (prior-year baseline × projected opponent coverage splits, 80/20 old/new blend); RaritosFootball Nota (EPA + success rate + pressure → 1–10 with attack/defense sub-ratings). When a builder reverse-engineers a public composite, look for this shape: weighted blend of public/paid inputs + a prior-year anchor + a normalization step.
- **Most of the signal is vendor-gated; the construction is what matters.** The valuable reverse-engineering targets are the open methodology + construction patterns, not the charted data (FTN, PFF, Statyx, SIS, ESPN PBWR are all gated).
- **New labels can surface without definitions:** "9YOE" (GridironInfo, 9/22) has no definition  -  unusable until the author defines it; flag as watch-item, do not guess.
- **Snap-qualification and tiny-sample traps:** the SumerSports PRWR min-25-snaps leaderboard was led by players with ~5 and ~3 snaps (Hunt 29.6%, Muhammad 27.3%)  -  the filter denominator was unclear from the screenshot. Treat unqualified or small-sample leaderboards as provisional; gate win-rate metrics on snap volume.
- **Chart-reads are approximate; formulas are exact.** Browser-task reads of rendered charts carry per-cell transcription risk  -  PARTIAL/APPROX flags exist for a reason. Author-stated formulas (ARBY's footer, ThunderDan's 80/20 blend, benbbaldwin's 40/40/20) are the reverse-engineering-grade material.
- **Position-aware baselines:** WillBrinson's caveat on the rushing-EPA chart  -  QB rushing (scrambles, situational runs) is not comparable to traditional RB rushing; keep position-aware reference lines.
- **Same caveat applies to explosive-play counts (@DETROlTLions313, Sep 23):** the Claude-built query excluded QB runs  -  Seattle's allowed 10+ rushes read 2 in the dashboard vs 4 manually counted (Drake Maye 16 and 10, Stevenson 12, Bam Knight 18). Any explosive-rush pipeline must explicitly include or exclude QB runs and say which; verify against other sources before comparing.
- **The backup-QB lesson (Keenum study):** no positional tell  -  rusty Keenum is not a TE guy or checkdown guy (WR 62.2% / TE 20.1% / RB 17.6% in return games). The "safety blanket" is role-based (slot / receiving RB / X) and follows the roster and scheme, not the QB. For DFS stacking or prop angles on backup QBs, identify the scheme's designated guy, not a position.
- **Descriptive ≠ predictive:** BAL posted a 16.6% higher success rate than NO and still lost (second-largest net success-rate upset since 2022); success-rate edges don't guarantee outcomes. Keep the engine's descriptive inputs separated from its outcome predictions.
- **Fourth-down aggressiveness as regime indicator:** 2026 W1–2 ≈ 16% vs 2025 ≈ 21% (ngreenberg/TruMedia). Early-season samples are small  -  don't over-fit; author's framing ("small-sample blip or new normal?") is the right posture.
- **nflverse pbp has no alignment data:** slot/X/Y/Z attribution needs charting data (FTN/PFF/Statyx). The Keenum blanket-role analysis required general-knowledge alignment notes  -  flag that boundary explicitly in any engine input.
- **the project owner's process lesson (Sept 24 pool notes):** his reads were directionally right and the actuals were slightly better than he remembered (DAL 29.7 FPG to TEs, not 27; Andrews 24.5% share, not 25%)  -  verify numerically before fading or following, but don't dismiss his directional instincts.
- **The no-code pipeline recipe is engine-replicable (@DETROlTLions313):** natural-language prompt → Claude → RStudio + nflreadr → BigQuery → Grafana. End-to-end verified by a third party. Cumulative EPA by play number (not by week) is a trend shape the engine can mirror for any quarterback.

- Weighted Opportunity: RB targets vs carries weighting  -  "Over the past 3 seasons, a RB target

- Pressure Rate Over Expectation (team OL rankings). YPRR charts. Data: FantasyPoints in-house

**@ihartitz (Ian Hartitz, 236.1K followers):**
- Relays TruMedia charts (pre-snap shift/motion, play-action %); does NOT build them himself
  (verbatim: "idk why they break it up that way but it's just play-a[ction percentage on dropbacks]").

**@joea_nfl (Joe, 11K followers):**
- Manual film charting; weekly "FINAL Week N Charts". Taxonomy: throw grades
  elite/great/solid/routine/bad/interceptable; play rows (sacks, no-fault sacks, throw-aways,
  runs, pocket moves, fumbles); metrics rows (accuracy %, accuracy+ %, +/− play %, Cheap Play %,
  PGP, letter grades).
- PGP (verbatim, Nov 1 2024): "The PGP algorithm was designed to, in theory, grant the perfectly
  average starter a 0.00. Over these hundreds of games, the average PGP is 0.14. The algo seems
  to be working. I grade on a bell curve. Average Starters are a C (2.0 GPA). The average game
  grade is 1.96."
- League baselines (verbatim, Nov 26 2023): "League average Negative Play rate: 29.1%. …
  League average positive play rate: 23.5%"
- Undisclosed: per-grade rubric, accuracy %/accuracy+ % formulas, Cheap Play % definition, PGP
  algorithm details.
- Public assets: free Patreon posts (2022) with grading legend (anchored to most-average NFL QB,
  e.g. Colt McCoy) + spreadsheet of every game graded + season composites + blank template;
  10,000 snaps graded for 2023.

**@gridironinfo_ (3,632 followers, joined Jul 2026):**
- Recurring: Playoff Probabilities series (preseason + weekly in-season), unit rankings, NGS
  Aggressiveness charts.
- Playoff-probability methodology (simulation vs formula) undisclosed. No code/data links.

**Gaps remaining:** @sfdata9ers percentile math + EPA source; @joea_nfl newer columns (Accuracy+,
Cheap Play %, PGP algo); @gridironinfo_ full trail; Barrett PROE formula + current xFP deltas;
@acccountstat averaging weights; SumerSports reproducible formulas (commercial).

### 1.4 Additional net-new metric/kernels from the sweeps (theories worth reverse-engineering)

- **WOPR vs Weighted Opportunity  -  DO NOT CONFLATE.** Marvin Elequin's WR WOPR (1.5 × Target
  Share + 0.7 × Air Yards Share) and Scott Barrett's RB Weighted Opportunity
  (1.28 × red-zone carries + 2.39 × red-zone targets + 0.47 × non-red-zone carries +
  1.54 × non-red-zone targets; full-PPR correlations: raw touches 0.89 → raw opportunities 0.90 →
  weighted opportunity 0.95 → red-zone-aware 0.97) are DIFFERENT metrics with the same name
  family  -  explicitly flagged in backend-gold.
- **TPRR/YPT/YPRR stabilization benchmarks** (archived Intentional Rounding research):
  TPRR ≈ 7 games (≈185 routes)  -  fastest; YPT ≈ 39 games (≈205 targets)  -  slowest. Via
  backend-gold §1.7 / §3.
- **Advanced Football Analytics glossary (long-standing public):** Air Yards = passing yards forward
  of LOS (total passing yards minus YAC); WP = probability of winning given score/time/field
  position/down/distance built on actual historical outcomes; WPA = WP(end) − WP(start); player
  WPA = sum over plays the player was directly involved in; EP = net expected point advantage of a
  down/distance/field-position situation (no score/time component).
- **@joea_nfl's grading anchor ("average-QB reference"):** most-average NFL QB (Colt McCoy; Andy
  Dalton or Kirk Cousins acceptable substitutes). Pedestrian = what you expect from average QB;
  Solid = nice/somewhat encouraging; Great = legitimately surprising; Elite = play average QB
  could never make (typically any 50+ air-yard throw). "I grade on a bell curve. Average Starters
  are a C (2.0 GPA)."
- **@joea_nfl thesis (post text, Sept 20):** QBs impacting the game less than in a decade; line play
  is everything; drops/busted routes rampant  -  qualitative market-read note for the engine's
  priors.
- **@ihartitz's core analytical set** (per his RotoWire "Stat Table Key"): target share, air
  yards/air-yard share, routes, TPRR, aDOT  -  opportunity metrics, not efficiency. Glossary: AY =
  air yards; Sn% = snap share; Rt% = route share; Tg% = team target share; AY% = team air-yard
  share; TPRR = targets per route run; aDOT = average depth of target; PROE = pass rate over
  expectation.
- **nflfastR model cards (public):** All principal models XGBoost. EP = 7-class next-score model
  (possession TD / opponent TD / possession FG / opponent FG / possession safety / opponent safety /
  no score); features: half seconds remaining, yard line, home possession, roof type, down, yards
  to go, era buckets, both teams' timeouts. Training: objective multi:softprob, num_class 7,
  nrounds 525, eta 0.025, gamma 1, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.8, max_depth 5,
  min_child_weight 1. Calibration: leave-one-season-out, probabilities binned to 0.05, checked
  against observed frequencies. WP features include `diff_time_ratio = point_differential ×
  exp(4 × (3600 − game_seconds_remaining) / 3600)`; spread model adds `spread_time =
  posteam_spread × exp(−4 × (3600 − game_seconds_remaining) / 3600)`. CP/xYAC features: yard line,
  home, roof, down, distance, air_yards − yards_to_go, era, air yards, zero-air-yard flag, middle
  vs non-middle throw, QB hit; xYAC adds distance from catch point to goal line. xPass features:
  yard line, home, roof, down, quarter, half time remaining, distance, score differential, timeouts,
  spread and non-spread WP, era. Model artifacts shipped: github.com/nflverse/fastrmodels
  (`ep_model`, `wp_model`, `wp_model_spread`, `fg_model`, `cp_model`, `xyac_model`, `xpass_model`).
- **ffopportunity (ffverse):** XGBoost + tidymodels trained on nflverse play-by-play 2006–2020.
  Scores every pass/rush play with expected values independent of actual outcome (completion
  probability, expected YAC, expected TD probability). `ep_load()` / `ep_build()`; output:
  ep_weekly (player-week, ~159 columns), ep_pbp_pass, ep_pbp_rush. Join key: gsis-style
  `00-00xxxxx` player IDs. License: code GPL-3.0; model outputs/data CC BY-SA 4.0 with
  attribution. Closest public equivalent of FantasyPoints' xFP  -  actual trained xgboost
  expected-fantasy-points model, runnable and redistributable.
- **sportsdataverse/nfl-data public ESPN-QBR reconstruction:** XGBoost regression against ESPN's
  published raw QBR on six features  -  qbr_epa, pass_epa, rush_epa, sack_epa, pen_epa, spread. EPA
  components are per-game win-probability-leverage-weighted means; EPA clamped at −5 (fumbles
  −3.5); plays in 0.1–0.2 or 0.8–0.9 home-WP bands get 0.9× weight, outside bands 0.6×. Explicitly
  notes public EPA cannot reproduce ESPN's private charting-based credit assignment. Player
  percentiles: qualification 14 dropbacks / 6.25 carries / 1.875 targets per team game; Weibull
  `100 × (n + 1 − rank) / (n + 1)` by season and position table; null metrics stay null.
- **dynastyprocess/data:** weekly GitHub Actions. `db_playerids.csv` cross-source player ID
  crosswalk (feeds nflreadpy load_ff_playerids); `db_fpecr` FantasyPros expert consensus rankings,
  updated weekly (feeds load_ff_rankings); `values.csv` dynasty trade values.
- **nflverse-data update cadence (public schedule page):** pbp + player/team stats nightly after
  game days (intra-day on game days); NFL stat corrections land Mon–Wed, so Thursday's pull is
  cleanest. Raw pbp JSON via `nflfastR::build_nflfastR_pbp()` usually within ~15 min of game end.
  FTN charting and PFR snap counts/advanced stats: 0/6/12/18 UTC daily. Rosters, depth charts,
  injuries: 7 AM UTC daily. NGS player-level weekly: nightly 3–5 AM ET. Depth charts from 2025:
  ISO8601-timestamped append-only updates. Participation: pre-2023 from NFL NGS (source died in
  2023 season); 2023+ courtesy of FTN, only after all postseason games.
- **nflreadpy loaders:** load_pbp, load_player_stats, load_team_stats, load_schedules, load_players,
  load_rosters, load_rosters_weekly, load_snap_counts, load_nextgen_stats, load_ftn_charting,
  load_participation, load_draft_picks, load_injuries, load_contracts, load_officials,
  load_combine, load_depth_charts, load_trades, load_ff_playerids, load_ff_rankings,
  load_ff_opportunity. MIT code license; most data CC-BY 4.0; FTN data CC-BY-SA 4.0.
- **Supporting public model repos:** greerreNFL/nfeloqb  -  public QB Elo ratings (qb_elos.csv),
  used by third-party fantasy pipelines (repo page not yet opened  -  verify before citing URL in
  public copy). nflverse-ts (TypeScript loaders)  -  full parity incl. loadPfrAdvstats (2018+),
  loadNextgenStats (2016+), loadFtnCharting (2022+ FTN, CC-BY-SA 4.0), loadFfOpportunity
  (weekly/pbp_pass/pbp_rush).
- **Barrett historical PFF xFP implementation (2019 article, still live):** 10-season NFL
  play-by-play sample; each target valued by distance from end zone AND depth of target; each
  carry valued by distance from end zone AND down-and-distance; sum play-level expected values;
  actual − xFP = points over expectation. Depth-adjusted YPT: expected YPT from every WR target
  since 2007 conditional on air-yard depth; metric = actual − expected; correlation with
  following-season targets rose from 0.28 (raw YPT) to 0.31 (depth-adjusted YPT over expectation).
- **PFF premium stats definitions (public):** Defensive stops = PFF-exclusive "win for the defense"
  formula; Elusive rating = yards after contact + missed tackles forced; Tackling efficiency =
  missed tackles per tackle attempt.
- **Open workstream queued (2026-09-21):** Stafford bounce-back multi-season base rates after a
  0-TD game with <200 yards; uncertainty-aware leg hit rates (Wilson intervals on small samples;
  n=1 splits flagged not headlined); render recommended visual  -  TPRR vs YPT stabilization chart
  (7 games vs 39 games) with GSE branding, or a "sample-size honesty" chart (Corum vs Johnson
  hit-rate distributions with CIs). Findings banked: Corum 2025 = 8 receptions in 17 games
  (0.47/g, not "multiple per game"); Theo Johnson 45 rec / 15 games (3.0/g, 14/15 games with ≥1);
  Adams-with/without-Puka split is n=1 on the out side.

---
equations: WOPR = 1.5 × Target Share + 0.7 × Air Yards Share. Week 2 WR leaders (approx from bars): [NFL-measured]
Solid = nice/somewhat encouraging; Great = legitimately surprising; Elite = play average QB [NFL-measured]

## 2. Backend-gold findings


### 2.1 Author-by-author compute tracing

**@scottbarrettdfb:** xFP historical PFF implementation (10-season sample; targets valued by
distance-from-end-zone × depth; carries by distance × down-and-distance); Depth-Adjusted YPT
(expected from every WR target since 2007 conditional on depth; 0.28 → 0.31 correlation with
next-season targets); RB Weighted Opportunity formula (published coefficients above); FantasyPoints
Data Suite current XFP (model over each play's context, recombined under chosen scoring system  - 
model card/coefficients behind closed beta). GAPS: current XFP deltas vs 2019; PROE formula (not
public anywhere).

**@ff_marvine:** WR WOPR = 1.5 × target share + 0.7 × team air-yards share; recurring series
"Fantasy Football Expected Points & Opportunity"; series index at
thefantasyfootballers.com/2025-ultimate-dfs-pass/dfs-pass-expectation-report/; metrics used:
targets, receptions, yards, TDs, target share, air yards, aDOT, YPRR, WOPR. GAP: whether his
expected-points numbers are his own build, nflfastR EPA-derived, or ffopportunity's model.

**@sfdata9ers:** No author-published methodology found. "Total QBR" matches ESPN's public Total QBR
labeling (not assumed to be his own composite). ESPN's public QBR description (proprietary
formula): all QB plays (pass, run, sack, penalty, turnover) valued by situation-weighted
EPA-like contribution, clutch weighting, partial credit split by air yards/YAC/pressure via
charting, scaled 0–100 with logistic regression. GAPS: data source(s), QBR derivation, update cadence.

**@joea_nfl:** Grading legend CLOSED from free 2022 Patreon posts (legend quotes in §1.3 above).
Process: every chart ships as spreadsheet (every game graded, season composites, summaries, blank
template); 2023: 10,000 snaps graded. Prefers letter-grade tiers over stack ranking.
Remaining GAPS: Accuracy+, PGP, Cheap Play %, positive/negative play % definitions.

**@pff:** Public methodology page (grading every player on every play since 2006; 200+ data points
per play; all-22; senior-analyst review loop). PFF Premium Stats definitions above (defensive
stops, elusive rating, tackling efficiency).

**@hawkblogger / SumerSports:** Public methodology is marketing-level only (human + AI evaluation,
frame-level info, per-snap player-role ID, receiver space creation and catch context, player
contribution grading). GAP: whitepapers/podcasts/conference material.

**@ihartitz:** RotoWire "Stat Table Key" glossary (§1.4). TPRR stabilization ≈ 7 games (~185 routes)
fastest; YPT ≈ 39 games (~205 targets) slowest. GAPS: TruMedia methodology; OddsJam methodology;
full post trail.

**@acccountstat:** Charts averaged across NFL Pro, PFF, SumerSports. GAP: simple vs weighted mean,
denominator alignment, missing/disagreement handling, definition normalization.

**@gridironinfo_:** No public methodology/website/repo/about found. GAP  -  entire trail.

### 2.2 Open backend infrastructure

- **nflfastR:** play-by-play back to 1999; cp/cpoe/xyac_epa/xyac_mean_yardage back to 2006; nightly
  in-season; all principal models XGBoost; full EP/WP/CP/xYAC/xPass feature lists and hyperparameters
  above (§1.4). Artifacts: github.com/nflverse/fastrmodels.
- **nflreadpy:** Python/Polars port; full loader list above; MIT code / CC-BY 4.0 data / CC-BY-SA 4.0 FTN.
- **nflverse-data releases:** teams, schedules, team stats, player stats, ESPN QBR, weekly rosters
  (NFL Shield v2 API back to 2002), players/ID mappings. Update cadence above.
- **ffverse/ffopportunity:** expected fantasy points XGBoost (2006–2020), ep_pbp_pass/rush parquets
  under `latest-data` tag, GSIS join keys, CC BY-SA 4.0 outputs.
- **dynastyprocess/data:** player-ID crosswalk, FantasyPros ECR weekly, dynasty trade values.
- **sportsdataverse/nfl-data:** nflfastR-parity pbp from NFL Shield API; models: EP, spread-WP, naive

title: NFL-RevEng | Digest 10 Sep 21 Deep | 3. NFL injury/concussion protocol notes (modeling-relevant)
body:
## 3. NFL injury/concussion protocol notes (modeling-relevant)


**Source:** `nfl-protocols/injury-concussion-protocol.md` (compiled 2026-09-21; CONFIRMED = official
NFL/NFLPA documents; REPORTED = secondary reporting).

### 3.1 Concussion game-day sideline evaluation (Rev. Oct 2022  -  current)

- **Initiators:** ATC, booth ATC, team physician, NFL official, coach, teammate, or UNC (Unaffiliated
  Neurotrauma Consultant). Player immediately removed to sideline (or stabilized on field).
- **Sideline survey:** No-Go check, History of Event, Concussion Signs/Symptoms, Maddock's Questions,
  Video Review, Focused Neurological Exam (cervical spine ROM/pain, speech, gait, eye movements +
  pupillary exam). Team Physician + UNC.
- **No-Go list (current):** loss of consciousness (LOC), **ataxia**, confusion, amnesia. Ataxia =
  "abnormality of balance/stability, motor coordination or dysfunctional speech caused by a
  neurological issue." Added October 2022 after the Tua Tagovailoa investigation; replaced "gross
  motor instability" and eliminated the "alternative explanation" loophole  -  ataxia observed at
  any point = no return, no exceptions.
- **No-Go sign at ANY point → NO RETURN TO PLAY** (rest of game minimum).
- Normal sideline survey + "benign" video review → may return.
- Any positive/inconclusive/suspicious → locker room full NFL SCAT + complete neurological exam;
  "Questionable to return  -  concussion".
- Progressive/worsening symptoms or abnormal locker room exam → NO RETURN TO PLAY.
- **"Madden Rule":** once a concussion is diagnosed, the player may not return to that game.
- **No set timeframe for return**  -  every concussion unique. **Daily monitoring** (or more frequent)
  through the entire protocol required.

### 3.2 Return-to-Participation Protocol  -  the five steps

**Gate rule (every step transition):** advance ONLY after demonstrating tolerance of ALL activities in
the current step without recurrence of observed/reported concussion signs/symptoms; recurrence →
stop, return to the **prior step**. Player must stay at pre-concussion baseline during exertion
AND a "reasonable period" after (Team Physician decides). Progression **may be accelerated** by
severity/time to baseline.
**Clearance authority:** Head Team Physician (or designated Team Physician) decides; **ALL
return-to-full-participation decisions must be confirmed by the Independent Neurological Consultant
(INC)**. INC must be informed at diagnosis. Final clearance = team medical staff decision
**confirmed by the INC**.

| Step | Name | Core content | Observable leak |
|------|------|--------------|-----------------|
| 1 | Rest and Recovery | Physical + relative cognitive rest; limit electronics/meetings until signs/symptoms + neuro exam (cognitive + balance) return to baseline | "DNP  -  Concussion" on practice report; "Out" on game status |
| 2 | Light Aerobic Exercise | Graduated CV exercise (bike, treadmill) under direct medical-staff oversight; dynamic stretching + balance; may attend meetings/film | DNP → Limited |
| 3 | Continued Aerobic + Strength | Increased supervised CV (may mimic sport-specific); supervised strength training; non-contact sport-specific conditioning (COD, cone drills) | Limited |
| 4 | Football-Specific Activities | Non-contact football (throwing, catching, running, position-specific). Strictly non-contact  -  no contact with players OR objects (dummies, sleds) | Limited (non-contact) |
| 5 | Full Football Activity / Clearance | After tolerating all above + meetings + conditioning + non-contact practice: (a) physician clears full contact → full practice; (b) clears to full participation; (c) INC examines, receives ALL reports incl. neurocognitive tests; (d) INC confirms → cleared for next game/practice | Full practice; off injury report / no game designation |

**Neurocognitive testing gates:** may be introduced any time after Step 1 or during Steps 2–3, MUST
be completed **before contact activities**; interpreted by team's neuropsychology consultant; if not
back to baseline → repeat at interval (typically 48 hours); Team Physician must evaluate
non-injury causes of any decrement. May do non-contact with abnormal testing; may NOT proceed to
contact until baseline OR physician determines non-concussion cause.

### 3.3 General injury track  -  practice participation + game status

- **Practice report designations:** DNP (did not participate), LP (limited participation), FP (full
  participation). Veteran rest / non-injury absence may be listed DNP/LP with labeled reason
  (e.g., NIR-Rest)  -  rest days permitted but must be labeled.
- **Cadence:** standard Sunday game → practice reports Wednesday, Thursday, Friday (Thursday/
  Saturday/Monday games shift the schedule).
- **Game status (binding):** **Out** = will not play; **Doubtful** = unlikely to play;
  **Questionable** = uncertain to play. Deadline **4:00 PM ET, two days before game day** (Friday
  for Sunday; Wednesday for Thursday). Certain-to-play players are removed from the report
  (explainable to the league; discipline possible if then deactivated). Status changes after the
  report must be re-reported.
- **"Probable" eliminated in 2016**  -  ~95% of "probable" players played, making it meaningless.
  Any availability question defaults to "Questionable". The separate "Out" category was also
  removed from the **practice** report.
- **Final word:** official inactive list (~90 minutes before kickoff).

### 3.4 Enforcement history (documented)

| Year | Club/individual | Violation | Penalty |
|------|-----------------|-----------|---------|
| 2025 (Oct) | Ravens ($100K) | Lamar Jackson listed Full Participant Friday while taking only scout-team reps (hamstring); retroactively downgraded to Limited, then ruled Out | $100K club fine; negligence  -  no draft picks |
| 2023 | Falcons ($75K) + HC Arthur Smith ($25K) | Bijan Robinson played limited Week 7 role with no injury designation; Saturday-night illness never added | $75K / $25K |
| 2019 | Steelers ($75K) + HC Mike Tomlin ($25K) | Ben Roethlisberger's elbow injury not accurately listed on practice report | $75K / $25K |

League rules language (quoted): *"A violation of the policy may result in Commissioner discipline,
which may include a fine on the involved club, fines or suspensions of involved individuals, as
well as the possible forfeiture of draft choices by the involved club."*

### 3.5 Concussion vs. general injury  -  structural differences

| Dimension | Concussion | General injury |
|-----------|-----------|----------------|
| Governing doc | NFL Head/Neck/Spine Committee protocols (+ NFLPA) | NFL Injury Report Policy (league ops) |
| Mandatory progression | Yes  -  5 graduated steps + regression on recurrence | No  -  team medical judgment |
| Same-game return | Prohibited once diagnosed; prohibited on any No-Go sign | Permitted if medically cleared |
| Independent clearance | Required  -  INC must confirm Team Physician | None |
| Cognitive testing | Mandatory neurocognitive baseline before contact; 48-hr retest | Not required |
| Minimum timeline | None fixed  -  step structure + INC gate makes sub-week returns rare | None  -  DNP Friday → play Sunday possible |
| Daily monitoring | Required | Not required |
| Observable signal | Practice participation (DNP→LP→FP = Steps 1–4); "Full" + no designation = Step 5 + INC done | Practice trend (Wed→Thu→Fri) primary; game status binding |
| Reporting surface | Same injury report | Same injury report |

### 3.6 GSE encoding notes (protocol-derived, not media-derived)

1. **Concussion = absorbing state until INC confirms.** Any "concussion" designation means the
   5-step progression is running. No legitimate same-week shortcut: beat-reporter speculation
   about a concussed player "practicing Friday" describes at most Step 3–4 (non-contact).
2. **The observable leak for concussions is practice participation.** DNP (concussion) → LP
   (concussion) maps to Steps 1–4. Encode the *transition*, not the beat writer's verb.
3. **Ataxia = automatic game-ender.** Since Oct 2022, any observed ataxia = no return, no
   exceptions, no "back injury" alternative explanation. Video showing it with a return = protocol
   violation story.
4. **For general injuries, the trend beats the label.** DNP→LP→FP = improving; FP→LP→DNP =
   deteriorating. Friday's designation is binding (Out = out; Doubtful ≈ out in practice).
   "Questionable" is the mandated bucket for *any* uncertainty since Probable was killed in 2016  - 
   not a 50/50 coin flip, it's a range.
5. **Rest vs. injury is labeled.** NIR-Rest / veteran rest days are permitted and labeled  -  don't
   model a rest DNP as an injury signal.
6. **Status changes must be re-reported.** A player added/downgraded after the Friday 4 PM ET
   report is itself a signal (the Bijan Robinson lesson  -  and a finable offense if hidden).

---

title: NFL-RevEng | Digest 10 Sep 21 Deep | 6. Drive-deep audits (condensed) / 6.1 Architectural blueprint  -  calibrated, tracking-decoupled sports probability engine
body:
### 6.1 Architectural blueprint  -  calibrated, tracking-decoupled sports probability engine


**Source doc thesis:** Build an elite, well-calibrated sports probability engine WITHOUT paying for
live 10Hz spatial tracking (licensing "typically exceeding hundreds of thousands of dollars
annually"; BDB/token-gated NGS scraping for commercial use violates non-commercial licensing/ToS).
Decouple the spatial tracking pipeline from the uncertainty/calibration engine. Harvest edge from:
(1) advanced uncertainty quantification, (2) distribution-free conformal calibration,
(3) continuous margin density evaluation (not point probabilities), (4) market microstructure
exploitation (Shin devigging, B-spline steam detection, state-transition latency arbitrage).
Raw coordinates via non-commercial datasets for offline method validation only; learned
architectures refit onto owned/open-source event data (nflverse) before anything commercial.
Three-tiered roadmap (Rungs 1–3: data integrity → predictive calibration → priceable execution),
fail-closed gates at every step. Unifying principle: survival under Knightian uncertainty  - 
no deep learning and no execution until data geometry and finite-sample guarantees are
"mathematically absolute."

**Key methods/gates:**
- **Performance model and market model kept DECOUPLED**  -  closing lines are never input features
  to team-strength models (would just parrot the oddsmaker). Prevents target leakage.
- **Physical-plausibility gating (Rung 1):** flag any player movement exceeding **13 m/s** as
  fatally corrupt (not an outlier); market series: reject non-finite timestamps
  (`SourceCannotSpeakAsOfError`); scan for fixture triplication, phantom matches from API timeouts,
  corrupted consensus metrics (e.g., public betting percentages pinned at exactly 1.0000 across a
  full MLB run-line slate); wind direction must not be naively averaged (mean of 0° and 359°
  wrongly yields 180°)  -  store as categorical strings or directional cosines. Design assumptions:
  market-data violation rate "well above five percent"; spatial datasets "approaching 19%" corrupt
  (approximate, attributed to raw-event-log audits).
- **Margin densities, not point probabilities:** migrate fully to densities  -  a density prices every
  alternate spread/total/teaser, is the only sound basis for pricing middles, maps where the
  market's whole probability curve diverges from fair. Valuation: true value = integral of the
  expected-points curve g_EP over the density f(y|s). Construction: map historical residual std
  onto the current point estimate → widened Gaussian baseline density → full PDF answering "what
  are fair odds at -1.5 through -4.5", not just "does -3.5 hold EV."
- **CRPS as the primary proper scoring rule:** abandon MAE (ignores variance) and binary Brier
  (can't evaluate continuous margins). CRPS = integral over x of [F(x) − 1{x ≥ y}]² dx. Gaussian
  closed form via Φ(z), φ(z). **Operational gate:** new density model must show CRPS improvement of
  <0.01 on ≥150 settled spreads vs. widened Gaussian baseline before live execution.
- **Conformal honesty package:** no clamped CQR; Jackknife+ (coverage 1−2α → exactly 80% at
  α=0.10, must be reported honestly) for NFL-scale n≈70; Generalized Venn-Abers (dual monotonic
  isotonic regressions via PAVA on calibration data augmented with both hypothetical test labels)
  for binary moneylines → epistemic multiprobability interval [p₀, p₁]; **if Δp > 0.20, market
  flagged unpriceable → fail closed, no position.**
- **Fake-tightness math (exact from doc):** k = ⌈(n+1)(1−α)⌉. α=0.10, n=5 → k=6>5 → empirical
  quantile at probability >1.0 forces ±∞. Naive clamp-to-max yields true coverage exactly
  5/6 = 83.33% while reporting 90%.
- **ACI:** updates nominal miscoverage α_t after every resolved event (widen when previous outcome
  fell outside); tuning γ; asymptotic coverage without full-model retraining  -  mid-season
  regime-change insulator.
- **Shin devigging:** reject proportional normalization (overweights favorites as lines grow
  extreme); Shin models overround as asymmetric defense against modeled insider-trading fraction;
  solves quadratic for insider parameter z; disproportionately removes vig from longshots, shading
  fair probabilities back toward midpoint. Most accurate reflection of bookmaker liability.
- **B-spline steam detection (Hawkes REJECTED):** Hawkes self-exciting processes rejected on
  short-horizon odds archives (weeks, not seasons)  -  fitting self-excitation on non-stationary
  short windows overfits to high-frequency noise. Replacement (parameter-free): RTS Kalman
  smoother strips bid-ask bounce → cubic B-spline parameterization → instantaneous curvature
  κ(t). Steam signature: extreme global maximum in κ(t) immediately accompanied by localized
  deceleration dip in trajectory velocity (market maker absorbing liquidity shock).
- **State-transition cost → latency arbitrage:** cornerback route-break reaction = 200–400 ms
  biomechanical penalty; market analog: books reprice at different speeds during forced 200–400 ms
  window → stale prices at slower secondary books → execute against stale book inside verified
  deceleration window for risk-free CLV.
- **Forecast-Skill E-process + robust Kelly:** anytime-valid sequential likelihood-ratio martingale
  rooted in Ville's inequality tests edge vs Shin-devigged consensus; capital unlocks only when
  E-process breaches predefined boundary; sizing = worst-case robust Kelly over Venn-Abers sets
  [p₀, p₁].
- **Method comparison tables:** MAE vs Brier vs CRPS (domain/characteristic/vulnerability); split
  CQR (n>200, exact 1−α) vs Jackknife+ (NFL n≈70, 1−2α) vs Generalized Venn-Abers (binary); devigging
  methods (proportional normalization / power method / Shin) with bias/vulnerability notes.

**Transfers:** CRPS as primary metric for spread/total densities (cheap Gaussian closed form; the
150-settled / 0.01 gate adoptable for model-version promotion, pairs with PR #96 leaderboard);
conformal honesty package (trust product  -  publish real coverage numbers + epistemic intervals with
exchangeability assumption named on surface); Shin devigging as market baseline (cheap: one
quadratic per market); physical-plausibility gating at ingestion (maps onto odds pipelines and
shadow engine PR #412); B-spline/RTS steam detection design decision; E-process for edge
verification; robust Kelly over [p₀, p₁]. **Doesn't transfer:** latency-arbitrage execution
(needs live multi-book execution infra; most ToS-sensitive; mirrors courtsiding-detection
reference); live 10Hz tracking pipeline (rejected by the doc itself); ACI online loop (needs
per-event resolution plumbing not yet built); full margin-density product (needs pricing surface  - 
adopt internally for CRPS scoring before exposing).

**Gaps:** no empirical validation anywhere (0.01/150 gate, Δp>0.20, 200–400 ms all asserted, not
estimated  -  starting priors, not findings); Jackknife+ LOO-refit compute cost hand-waved; conflict
risk with GSE's split-CQR lane (likely outcome: CQR for large-n props/DFS pools, Jackknife+ for
NFL sides/totals  -  needs reconciliation with the conformal audit doc); Shin's z unidentified from
two-way odds alone (no equation printed); VERSA name-dropped, never defined; ESOE invoked, never
defined; ACI's γ, E-process boundary, robust-Kelly formulation all named without equations/values;
tracking-lane legal posture would push NGS material to offline validation  -  needs explicit
decision.

title: NFL-RevEng | Digest 10 Sep 21 Deep | 6. Drive-deep audits (condensed) / 6.2 Conformal prediction, small-sample calibration, sports market probabilities  -  audit
body:
### 6.2 Conformal prediction, small-sample calibration, sports market probabilities  -  audit


**Thesis:** standard point forecasters and uncalibrated quantile regressions exhibit systematic
finite-sample under-coverage whenever feature dimension is non-trivial relative to sample size.
Wrap every publishable prediction in distribution-free conformal machinery; operate FAIL-CLOSED:
whenever the calibration sample is too small to certify the nominal quantile, emit an infinite
interval or refuse to publish (No-Bet), never clamp the quantile to the largest observed residual.
Central slogan: "eliminate fake tightness."

**Exact formulas:**
- **CQR** (Romano, Patterson & Candès 2019, arXiv:1905.03222): E_i =
  max(q_α_lo(X_i) − Y_i, Y_i − q_α_hi(X_i)); Q_{1−α}(E; I₂) = ⌈(1−α)(|I₂|+1)⌉-th largest
  element; C(X_{n+1}) = [q_α_lo − Q, q_α_hi + Q]. Guarantee P(Y∈C) ≥ 1−α under exchangeability.
- **Jackknife+** (Barber, Candès, Ramdas & Tibshirani 2019, arXiv:1905.02928): LOO residuals
  R_i^LOO = |Y_i − μ_{−i}(X_i)|; interval [q_α^−(μ_{−i}(X_{n+1}) − R_i^LOO),
  q_{1−α}^+(μ_{−i}(X_{n+1}) + R_i^LOO)]; guarantee ≥ 1−2α.
- **Split conformal** (Angelopoulos & Bates 2021, arXiv:2107.07511): q_hat = ⌈(n+1)(1−α)⌉/n
  empirical quantile; level δ must satisfy δ ≥ 1/(n+1) (Dietterich & Hostetler 2022,
  arXiv:2206.04860).
- **The n=5, α=0.10 hand computation:** inflation factor (1−α)(1+1/n) = 0.90×1.20 = 1.08; rank
  k = ⌈6×0.90⌉ = 6 > 5 → quantile at 1.08 (>1.0) yields +∞. Minimum n for α=0.10: n ≥ ⌈1/α⌉−1 = 9.
  Clamped coverage = 5/6 ≈ 83.33%; under-coverage defect 6.67%.
- **ACI:** α_{t+1} = α_t + γ(α − err_t), err_t = 1{Y_t ∉ C_t}. Asymptotic coverage under
  arbitrary shifts; NO finite-sample marginal guarantee over an 18-week NFL schedule.
- **EnbPI:** aggregates bootstrap ensemble forecasts over rolling horizons.
- **SPCI:** s_t = f(s_{t−1},…,s_{t−p}) + e_t; valid finite-sample intervals provided the residual
  time series remains stationary.
- **Rolling-origin CP:** calibrate against m most recent pseudo-OOS forecast errors; for a
  structured 272-game NFL season, sliding window m = 32 to 64 games.
- **SPI:** augments scarce calibration sets with synthetic samples from domain priors.
- **Binary calibration:** Platt scaling; Isotonic Regression (PAVA)  -  requires pre-coalescence of
  tied scores (internal GSE note [16]: aggregate equal-score labels and weights before PAV);
  Venn-Abers (generalized, van der Laan & Alaa 2025, arXiv:2502.05676) → [p₀, p₁];
  impossibility result (Barber et al. 2020, EJS): bounded-length distribution-free CIs for π(X)
  impossible without structural assumptions.
- **Calibration metrics/gates:** ECE  -  fail-closed above 0.05; Brier; Venn-Abers width  -  PROVEN
  gate: refuse moneyline pick / No-Bet if p₁−p₀ > 0.20; Clopper-Pearson exact binomial CIs for
  sample win rates  -  withhold public performance displays until n ≥ 30 (internal PR #454:
  headline + per-bucket 95% Clopper-Pearson on decided picks, five equal-mass + equal-width
  quantile buckets); CLV  -  partition models into release-time snapshots; incorporating
  near-game-time lines into training leaks future information; Mondrian conformal  -  subgroup
  calibration across sports for equalized marginal coverage; Nested Conformal / QOOB (2019):
  F_t(x) = {y : score(x,y) ≤ t}, calibrating t via OOB cross-splits.
- **Linear QR under-coverage bias** (Lin, Trivedi & Sun 2021): for α>0.5 and small d/n, the
  α-quantile "roughly achieves coverage α − (α−1/2)·d/n" regardless of noise distribution.

**Operational plan (n=5 vs n=500 at α=0.1):** fail-closed at n=5 (infinite intervals/No-Bet,
Jackknife+ or SPI substitutes, Venn-Abers for binaries with p₁−p₀>0.20 refusal, Clopper-Pearson
CIs, no public displays below n=30); fully operational split CQR at n=500 (k=451, pinball-loss
quantile nets/GBTs for 0.05/0.95 quantiles, SPCI/rolling-origin for time series, isotonic PAVA
with tie pre-coalescence, Venn-Abers + Platt for binaries, CLV verification, Mondrian subgroup
calibration, Brier/ECE audit gates).

**Known live defect (verified 2026-09-21 in `apps/web/lib/calibration/cqr.ts`):** `conformalQuantile()`
line ~15: `rank = Math.min(Math.max(rank, 0), n - 1);`  -  clamps the rank to max(n)−1 instead of
emitting +∞ when ⌈(1−α)(n+1)⌉−1 ≥ n. E.g., n=5, α=0.1: rank=⌈5.4⌉−1=5 → clamped to 4 → returns max
residual, falsely certifying 90% coverage while delivering 83.33%. Its tests "explicitly expect
the wrong behavior" (doc quote).  -  NOTE: WIRING-PLAN records this as repaired 2026-09-22 (commit
`1d38140`); verify against the live checkout.

**Table 2 internal evidence log (GSE):** 2026-09-17 "My conformal fix was incomplete. cqr.ts
contains the same small-sample quantile clamp, and its tests explicitly expect the wrong
behavior. Still unfixed."; 2026-08-09 PR run failed CI (a41113d); 2026-08-19 PAV tie-coalescence
note [16]; 2026-07-24 tuneTau vs ivap/cvap legacy-gate note [22]; 2026-08-21 Clopper-Pearson CI
layer [23].

**Gaps:** Table 1's "Exchangeable (Y/N)" and "Source ID" columns blank in conversion; Table 2's
"From/Sender" cells blank; citation keys [11]–[23] can't be fully mapped to the flat bibliography;
SPI hand-waved (no domain-prior construction); nested/QOOB row thin; conflict with Schröder et
al. (arXiv:2402.16300) truncation-tolerant selective regression  -  auditor rejects for GSE as fake
tightness; images from source docx not extracted; internal HEARSAY demotion contradicts Table 2's
reliance on internal hits.

title: NFL-RevEng | Digest 10 Sep 21 Deep | 6. Drive-deep audits (condensed) / 6.3 CQR research survey (compiled brief, 8,154 lines / ~506k chars)
body:
### 6.3 CQR research survey (compiled brief, 8,154 lines / ~506k chars)


Three-part compiled survey: (A) 100 numbered arXiv abstract fragments (conformal/UQ, 1905.xxxxx →
2609.xxxxx); (B) earlier batch of 60 papers (2019–2026)  -  foundational deep analysis (7 papers) +
detailed coverage + synthesis; (C) detailed coverage of all 100 Part-A fragments (foundational/
theoretical, time series & sequential, energy/climate, astronomy/physics, synthesis); (D) raw
arXiv listing dump (~5,070 lines, mostly tangential stat.ML/stat.ME).

**Foundational formulas (Part B):**
- **CQR** (1905.03222): E_i = max{q̂_{α/2}(X_i) − Y_i, Y_i − q̂_{1−α/2}(X_i)};
  C(x) = [q̂_{α/2}(x) − Q̂_{1−α}(E), q̂_{1−α/2}(x) + Q̂_{1−α}(E)]; P(Y∈C(X)) ≥ 1−α under
  exchangeability; intervals adapt to heteroscedasticity. Limitations: needs quantile regression
  training (hard with limited data/complex architectures); exchangeability assumption  -  unsuitable
  for time series without modification.
- **Jackknife+** (1905.02928): [α-th quantile of {μ̂_{−i}(X_{n+1}) − |Y_i − μ̂_{−i}(X_i)|},
  (1−α)-th quantile of {μ̂_{−i}(X_{n+1}) + |Y_i − μ̂_{−i}(X_i)|}]; ≥1−2α coverage for any symmetric
  algorithm, any distribution; original jackknife can have zero/vanishing coverage; jackknife+ fix
  = LOO predictions at the test point, not just residuals. Extends to K-fold CV.
- **Nested conformal + QOOB** (1910.10562): nested sets F_t(x) = {y : score(x,y) ≤ t}, calibrate t;
  CQR score recovered exactly from nested-set perspective; QOOB = QR + cross-conformalization +
  ensembles + OOB predictions, avoiding train/calibration split inefficiency; unifying framework
  for cross-conformal, jackknife+, other data-efficient methods.
- **Reweighting nonconformity scores** (2303.12695): Quantile Regression Forest learns score
  distribution; w_i = ρ(x_i, x_{n+1}) / ((1/n)∑_j ρ(x_j, x_{n+1})); weighted empirical quantile →
  interval adapts to local difficulty.
- **KOWCPI** (2405.16828): RNW estimator for QR on dependent data; data-adaptive kernel weights
  with temporal proximity weighting; conditional coverage theory under strong mixing; narrower
  intervals without losing coverage on real TS data.
- **Missing values** (2306.02732): theorem  -  if data exchangeable (A1) and imputation function
  symmetric (A2), then impute-then-predict+conformalization is *marginally* valid for any
  missingness (even MNAR) and almost all imputation functions. Caveat: mask-conditional coverage
  can fail dramatically (heteroskedasticity).
- **SEMF** (2405.18176): EM over latent targets, Monte Carlo sampling, VAE-like; works with
  XGBoost/MLPs; 11 tabular datasets; honest limitation: robustness diminishes with missing data.
- **Other claims:** view-structured CP (2609.10307)  -  two-level guarantee; EOC/BFQR (2311.02243,
  NeurIPS 2023)  -  equal opportunity of coverage; Colorful Pinball (2512.24139, ICML 2026)  - 
  density-weighted QR; skew-adaptive CP (PMLR 329, 2026)  -  residual-skewness-adjusted asymmetry;
  HQR + WACI (2406.14904); ProbFM (2601.10591)  -  transformer TSFM with aleatoric/epistemic
  decomposition; QUTCC (2507.14760)  -  imaging hallucination error bars; Extreme CP (2505.08578)
   -  EVT intervals for 99.9% levels; SPI (2505.13432, co-author Romano)  -  synthetic calibration
  data; AS-CQR (2606.00506, KDD 2026)  -  adaptive sequential CQR on GE-Mamba.
- **Sparse empirical results:** forward collision warning (2511.19952, NGSIM)  -  73% faster
  inference than Transformers, ADE 0.73 m (42.2% better than Social_LSTM), CQR 91.3% coverage at
  90% nominal; steel fatigue (2608.07589)  -  first CP application, 7 methods, 50 splits; smart
  irrigation (2609.13864)  -  90%-nominal CP, 3 years hourly data; Self-Organized CP (2606.29403)
   -  44 pages, 8→10 benchmarks; German EPEX electricity 2015–2023; AION-1 UQ benchmark (7 methods);
  Jumbo-Visma calorie prediction (2304.03778)  -  explicit CP bake-off (jackknife+, jackknife-minmax,
  CV+, CV-minmax, CQR), numeric winner not visible.

title: NFL-RevEng | Digest 10 Sep 21 Deep | 6. Drive-deep audits (condensed) / 6.5 World-class sports probability engine corpus audit
body:
### 6.5 World-class sports probability engine corpus audit


**Thesis:** the most calibrated engine requires (a) decoupling latent performance forecasting
from market pricing dynamics, (b) team/player strength as a stochastic process with
sport-specific noise and likelihoods  -  never a single global calibration head, (c) finite-sample
validity via conformal methods (CQR for intervals, Venn-Abers for binary moneylines) with
fail-closed policy under scarcity, (d) anytime-valid sequential E-processes rather than fixed-n
p-values. Large share of the audited corpus is keyword-inflated "feature bloat" or dead domains
 -  excise from the research pipeline.

**Engine architecture (PR #412 design):** `shadow-evaluation-pass.ts`  -  persistent shadow-only
evaluation loop, no live picks committed. **TeamStrengthFilter:** Ensemble Transform Kalman Filter
(ETKF) modeling latent team strength as sequential Monte Carlo particle filter; survives
serverless cold starts via PostgreSQL persistence (`FilterStateSnapshot`, `ShadowSignal`).
**VERSA:** state-transition verification gates against silent data corruption at ingestion.
**Liveness:** `scheduler-liveness.ts` + `traffic-heartbeat.ts` failsafe. **hawkes-steam.ts:**
per-side exponential-decay Hawkes self-exciting process with online intensity updates to detect
clustered informed betting pressure ("steam"), separating organic background volatility from
momentum-driven line movement. **forecast-skill-eprocess.ts** (LiveOrchestrator): anytime-valid
sequential likelihood-ratio martingale under Ville's inequality testing H0: model probabilities
no better than market consensus. **robust-kelly.ts:** robust Kelly fraction calculator as the
barrier between theoretical probability and financial deployment.

**State-space imperative:** latent strength must be a stochastic process with sport-specific
σ_game; signal-to-noise strictly domain-specific (NBA-calibrated model catastrophically
miscalibrates on MLB and vice versa). Diagnostic baselines before any deep net: independent
Poisson processes and iWinRNFL tools. **Mandatory loss shift: BCE → Brier loss**  -  NCAA-data
evaluations prove training under Brier loss "drastically optimizes baseline point-estimate
calibration." Failure mode named: raw box scores into unconstrained ML heads (e.g., GBTs on
binary classification framing) discards domain topology → severe empirical miscalibration.

**CQR:** un-conformalized QR systematically under-covers in finite samples; parameter estimation
error ∝ d/n; raw NN/boosted quantile outputs are strictly *uncalibrated proposal distributions*.
Recipe: train lower/upper quantile regressors with asymmetric pinball loss; residuals on strictly
held-out calibration set as non-conformity scores; empirical quantile of scores; inflate/deflate
bounds → coverage 1−α under exchangeability. Non-conformity score (exact, recovered from docx
equation image): E_i = max(q̂_{α_lo}(X_i) − Y_i, Y_i − q̂_{α_hi}(X_i)). Conformal rank index
k = ⌈(n+1)(1−α)⌉. **Quantile-clamping result (central numerical argument):** n=5, α=0.10 →
k=6>5 → empirical quantile forced to +∞; clamp-to-n=5 = "mathematically catastrophic": true
coverage n/(n+1) ≈ 83.33%, 6.67pp under-coverage defect while presented as 90% ("fake
tightness"). Rule: ban quantile clamping; when n < ⌈1/α⌉−1 → [−∞,+∞] or automated No-Bet.
Scarcity alternative: Jackknife+ (≥1−2α) for early-season prop markets.

**Generalized Venn-Abers:** CQR residual math applied to binary moneyline outcomes Y∈{0,1} is
mathematically invalid. Mandated: compute exact multiprobability bounds [p₀,p₁] via dual
isotonic regressions on calibration set. Width (p₁−p₀) = rigorous epistemic uncertainty from
data paucity. Selective gate: if p₁−p₀ > 0.20 (example safety threshold) → refuse pick, No-Bet.
Pair with Platt scaling for well-calibrated large-n environments → precise point probabilities
alongside narrow calibrated bounds for EV vs market.

**Market efficiency / target leakage / E-processes:** closing lines / near-game odds as input
features to team-strength models = severe target leakage (model parrots consensus, can never
measure true CLV). Pure performance engine: signal only from play-by-play efficiency, spatial
tracking, box-score aggregates; market dynamics in separate subsystem (Hawkes steam detector).
**Testing by betting:** Forecast-Skill E-process (anytime-valid sequential likelihood-ratio
martingale under Ville's inequality) tests H0: model no better than market consensus. P-values
require fixed sample sizes and fail under continuous monitoring; E-process compounds evidence
continuously. Martingale multiplying theoretical risked capital by a significant factor =
mathematically sound proof of edge without absorbing-zero failures or p-hacking.

**Cross-domain horizons (fluid dynamics + AGI swarms):** soccer-pitch player/ball movement as
smooth predominantly irrotational velocity vector fields (Navier-Stokes-inspired); latent scalar
potentials as team-specific fingerprints; potential gradients associate with effective ball
progression. Stamina factor: top speed as variable parameter ξ adjusting dynamic pressure gradient
 -  quantifies individual physical decline's direct mathematical impact on team pitch control. Drag
coefficients/drafting modeled explicitly in multi-competitor environments. MARL frameworks to
simulate counterfactual game states and auto-test game-theory boundaries.

**Table 1  -  state-space structural components:** Observation Mapping (betting-market spreads and
totals-implied margins  -  standardizes evaluation across NFL/NBA/NHL/MLB); Temporal Evolution
(AR(1) decay between seasons; random walk within seasons); Variance Heterogeneity (sport-specific
σ_game  -  NBA massive talent dispersion and home advantage; NHL/MLB "approach coin-flips given
equal talent"); Generative Likelihoods (truncated negative binomials  -  volleyball; log-linear
Poisson  -  rugby/soccer  -  outputs respect domain constraints: no negative scores, win-by-two
rules).

**Table 2  -  fluid dynamics → sports analytics:** irrotational vector fields (aggregate player
trajectories → empirical velocity vectors on mesoscale grid  -  captures continuous multi-agent
movement fluxes); latent scalar potentials (encode how teams control/constrain play across space
in attacking/defensive phases  -  physically interpretable off-ball gravity / defensive fragility);
stamina factor & velocity (top speed ξ adjusting dynamic pressure gradient  -  quantifies physical
decline → impact on pitch control); drag coefficients & drafting (race-level drafting effects  - 
separates individual ability from within-race spatial strategy for counter-factual analysis).

**Table 3  -  corpus ledger (278 rows; SHEET=258, READ=20):** GSE-relevant=Y: 155/278;
sheet_inflated=Y: 123/278. Columns: id | sheet_tier | cluster | disposition | 12-word summary |
GSE-relevant | sheet_inflated. Clusters: Diagnostics, State-Space, Tracking, Market, Ranking,
Feature Bloat. READ-disposition shortlist: 2607.06495 (calibrated real-time Monte Carlo engine,
NL race-strategy briefings  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y); 2602.00676 (large-scale imperfect-information
game benchmark, GuanDan card games  -  Diagnostics, GSE=N); 2402.07004 (min-max transformation for
PIR metric sports performance  -  State-Space, GSE=Y); 2101.05388 (evaluating soccer players from
live camera feeds via deep RL  -  Tracking, GSE=Y); 2012.04380 (combining ML and human expert text
to predict football outcomes  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y); 2010.15891 (multi-agent trajectory
prediction, fuzzy query attention  -  Tracking, GSE=Y); 2010.12508 (**proves profitability by
explicitly decorrelating predictions from consensus market pricing lines**  -  Market, GSE=Y  - 
direct evidence for the decoupling thesis); 2405.19125 (early detection of critical urban events
via mobile network data  -  Feature Bloat, GSE=N, inflated=Y); 2306.14462 (multi-task
item-attribute graph pre-training, cold-start e-commerce  -  Feature Bloat, GSE=N, inflated=Y);
1910.08670 (context-driven data mining, bias removal, incompleteness mitigation  -  Diagnostics,
GSE=Y); 1904.13178 (fine-grained entity recognition  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y); 2302.00911
(conditional expectation with regularization for missing-data imputation  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y);
2301.10052 (football event detection via GCN  -  Tracking, GSE=Y); 2410.07401 (soccer camera
calibration via keypoint exploitation  -  Tracking, GSE=N, inflated=Y); 2311.04726 (social motion
prediction with cognitive hierarchies, multi-person team-sports trajectory forecasting  - 
Tracking, GSE=Y); 2607.07498 (reward-adaptive iterative discovery, automated game testing /
exploit finding for NHL26  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y); 2603.24023 (two-phase fine-tuning for
high-efficiency Text-to-SQL at scale in cricket apps  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y); 2302.06569
(inferring multi-agent player locations from sparse event data, LSTM+GNN  -  Tracking, GSE=Y  - 
relevant to NFL NGS work without full tracking feeds); 2301.08190 (Tsetlin Machine clause-size
constraints for interpretability  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y); 2402.10979 (SportsMetrics benchmark,
LLMs fusing textual+numerical sports data  -  Diagnostics, GSE=Y). Inflation call-outs:
2501.17711 (STGCN-LSTM Olympic medals, Score 19  -  keep only Zero-Inflated Compound Poisson
head); 1607.00379 (2014 frozen-PyMC3 Six Nations tutorial  -  conceptual only); 2607.23509 (TDA
for ATP tennis while core engines struggle vs simple MAE baselines  -  mis-prioritized). Dead
domains: brain strain criteria / head impact biomechanics, parallel MRI reconstruction, neutron
star equations of state, automotive CFD.

**Transfers:** quantile-clamping ban + fail-closed conformal policy (concrete defect class to grep
codebase for); Venn-Abers multiprobability bounds for moneylines (principled "refuse the pick"
mechanism); decoupling + Hawkes steam + E-process (matches existing shadow pipeline; mathematical
justification); per-sport state-space with σ_game + BCE→Brier loss (cheap experiment vs GSE
training); robust Kelly gating (already exists as robust-kelly.ts  -  audit endorses); Table 3
READ shortlist (esp. 2010.12508 on decorrelating from consensus; 2302.06569 on inferring player
locations from sparse event data  -  relevant to NFL NGS without full tracking). **Do NOT build:**
AGI agent-swarm / Navier-Stokes proof narrative (YouTube Shorts anecdote, no implementation
path); fluid-dynamics-as-engine for current NFL scope; 123/278 inflated ledger rows + dead
domains; the 26x/25x ID queue (reading list only, not findings).

**Gaps:** unverifiable flagship claims (2026 OpenAI-Navier-Stokes narrative sourced to YouTube
Shorts  -  conflicts with standing GSE rule: no claim built on without lab execution); no GSE
empirical results of its own (architecture + literature, no backtest/CLV/calibration numbers from
the repo pipeline); 22 equation PNGs dropped by conversion (recovered via rendering for this
note  -  anyone reading only the .md misses the formulas); p₁−p₀>0.20 threshold is example policy,
not derived; Jackknife+ interval-width cost of LOO refits at GSE scale unquantified; "ban ML
heads" polemic is narrower than it reads (unconstrained binary-classification heads discard
domain topology  -  tree/NN components remain valid as quantile-regressor proposal distributions
inside conformal wrappers  -  the audit explicitly endorses that usage); corpus-audit overlap with
sibling docs (cross-check before treating as independent evidence).

---

title: NFL-RevEng | Digest 10 Sep 21 Deep | 7. LESSONS  -  mistakes caught, standards, gotchas
body:
## 7. LESSONS  -  mistakes caught, standards, gotchas


**Task rule (backend-gold):** never bypass logins, paywalls, or access controls; no social
interaction (no likes, follows, replies, reposts, forms). Public-web-only research; every formula
sourced from a primary public source linked inline; anything not found marked GAP rather than invented.

**Neutral-inventory standard (sweeps):** metric name, definition as given, columns/sample values,
date/account, data source as stated, caveats as attributed facts  -  no verdicts.

**Fake tightness / quantile clamping (the central caught defect):** a small-sample CQR quantile
clamp (`rank = Math.min(Math.max(rank, 0), n - 1)` in `apps/web/lib/calibration/cqr.ts`) was
caught and documented: at n=5, α=0.10 it falsely certifies 90% coverage while delivering 83.33%
(a 6.67pp under-coverage defect), and its tests explicitly encoded the wrong behavior. Standing
rule: ban ALL quantile clamping; emit +∞/No-Bet when n < ⌈1/α⌉−1. Repaired 2026-09-22 per
wiring-plan (`1d38140`)  -  re-verify against live checkout.

**Name-confusion traps (do NOT conflate):** Barrett's RB Weighted Opportunity (coefficient formula
above, full-PPR) vs. Marvin's WR WOPR (1.5×TS + 0.7×AY%)  -  different metrics, same name family.
PFF's xFP (2019 article, public formula) vs. FantasyPoints Data Suite current XFP (behind closed
beta  -  deltas unknown). CQR math must NEVER touch binary moneylines (mathematically invalid for
Y∈{0,1})  -  binaries go to Venn-Abers. Closing lines / near-game odds as input features to
team-strength models = severe target leakage (model parrots consensus, CLV unmeasurable).
Average-quality trap: un-conformalized QR under-covers in finite samples (error ∝ d/n)  -  raw
NN/boosted quantile outputs are strictly *uncalibrated proposal distributions*.

**Jackknife+ reporting honesty:** guarantees 1−2α, NOT 1−α. At α=0.10 → exactly 80% guaranteed
coverage, not 90%. Track/log/report explicitly. The blueprint doc caught itself on this
emphasized correction.

**Venn-Abers threshold arbitrariness:** p₁−p₀ > 0.20 is an example policy value, not a derived
constant  -  calibrate on shadow data before adopting as a gate. ACI's asymptotic coverage does
NOT certify anything over an 18-week NFL season (no finite-sample guarantee)  -  don't cite it as
one.

**Data-freshness / update-cadence rules:** NFL stat corrections land Mon–Wed  -  Thursday's pull
is the cleanest. Raw pbp JSON within ~15 min of game end. Rosters/depth charts/injuries 7 AM UTC
daily. NGS player-level weekly: nightly 3–5 AM ET. nflverse participation: pre-2023 source died
in 2023 season; 2023+ courtesy of FTN, only after all postseason games.

**Small-sample honesty:** uncertainty-aware leg hit rates use Wilson intervals; n=1 splits are
flagged, not headlined. Public performance displays withheld until n ≥ 30 (Clopper-Pearson 95%
CIs). n ≥ 100 settled games before NFL PASS recommendations; n ≥ 1,000 to claim calibration.
"No stats I post are fake, but these ones are 'made up' in the sense that I combined different
stats and sources to improve reliability from a small 1 week sample size" (@acccountstat)  -  an
explicitly disclosed small-sample blend, the honest pattern vs. fake tightness.

**Model-honesty rules:** per-sport noise scales  -  a single global calibration layer is
"mathematically unsound" (1701.05976); never share calibration across sports. Train under Brier
loss, not BCE, for calibration (empirical: LSTM+Brier → 0.159 vs Transformer+BCE highest AUC
0.847). Release-time snapshot partitioning for CLV  -  never train on near-game-time lines. Dual
CLV reporting (Decided 40.8% / System 23.2%) side by side, vs 52.4% break-even floor. Inverted
confidence metrics (Brier 0.3617, z=−10.7) = anti-predictive  -  purge from any public surface.
Sort by marketFairProb (Shin/Power devigged consensus, Brier 0.2189) until the model
demonstrably beats the close. "Questionable" is a mandated range, not a 50/50  -  since 2016.
Rest DNPs (NIR-Rest) are not injury signals. Purge "AI" marketing copy (hygiene governance).
Physical plausibility: player movement >13 m/s = fatally corrupt telemetry (not an outlier);
wind direction is not naively averaged (store as categorical or directional cosines); non-finite
timestamps = hard error.

**Wiring discipline:** additive-only  -  new modules + tests, nothing existing touched, nothing
wired into live publish paths (waves 1–2: 454 + 624 implemented, 1,248 + files, zero modified/
deleted). Publish-path wiring (W-1 quantile isotonization, decision modules) = NEEDS HUMAN CALL
with pre-registered acceptance gates. schema.prisma/migrations frozen to agents (law 2); DB reads
forbidden to agents (law 7)  -  fixture dating fix stays upstream. Prop storage blocked on `PROP`
in Prisma PickType (human schema change). 31 hierarchical-Bayes prop models in
`packages/prediction-engine/src/edge-lab/` wired to quote-plane  -  storage only blocker.
Training programs (AutoGluon, TimesFM/Chronos/Mamba, LLM fine-tunes, JAGS/Stan weather) are not
small modules  -  deferred as programs. Hawkes steam detection rejected on short-horizon odds
archives (overfits to high-frequency noise)  -  replaced by parameter-free RTS Kalman + cubic
B-spline curvature geometry (in the blueprint; the engine's hawkes-steam.ts predates this).
Features W5–W8 (Wasserstein, DFA, Intrinsic Dimension, Permutation Entropy): 12/12 failed →
permanently killed. Mondrian-k calibration ΔCRPS=0.0092 < 0.01 threshold → killed. QB-change
variance scaling τ²=1.379 < 1.50 kill threshold → killed. Spread×Total correlation ρ=0.016 →
independence kept. Hawkes branching ratio n̂=0 → momentum rejected.

**Conversion/extraction gotchas:** equation images dropped by python-docx→markdown (corpus audit's
22 PNGs recovered by rendering; anyone reading only the .md misses the formulas). Table columns
blank in conversion (conformal audit's Exchangeable Y/N and Source ID; Table 2 From/Sender). The
cqr-research.md file is a compiled survey, not a single paper (three batches + raw dump; heading
mistyped `## . arXiv:2609.17091`; entry numbering inconsistent  -  8–118). Abstract-fragment papers
(100-paper batch) are metadata-level, not evidence-level. Papers cited with 2026 venues/dates
(ICML 2026, KDD 2026, COPA 2026) are future-dated acceptances  -  taken at face value from the
source docs. The 2026 "OpenAI solved Navier-Stokes" narrative is a YouTube Shorts anecdote, not
a paper  -  unverifiable, conflicts with the no-claims-without-lab-execution rule. Rolling-Origin
CP listed as "2026"  -  either a 2026 preprint or transcription artifact, unverified. Operational
states (PR numbers, CI run #2948, watchdog RED since 2026-09-13 16:53 UTC, 2026-09-24 board gate,
2026-10-08 EPA activation) are 2026-09-19/21 snapshots  -  re-verify against the live repo before
acting.

**Research-hygiene rules from the audits:** conformal wrappers guarantee coverage but cannot
repair point-estimate bias (fix Brier/ECE of the point model first). Raw boosted/NN quantile
outputs are proposal distributions, not calibrated intervals. Dixon-Coles bivariate Poisson /
soccer Skellam params barred from NFL scoring (boundary conditions break Poisson). Feature bloat
killed until baseline MAE/calibration competitive (STGCN-LSTM, soccer vector fields, TDA, fluid
dynamics layer, AGI swarm  -  vision/horizon material, not engineering). Ten dead-domain papers
excluded (matched generic keywords only). 2010.12508 = direct evidence for the
decouple-from-consensus thesis (profitability via explicitly decorrelating predictions from
consensus pricing lines). GreerreNFL/nfeloqb URL unverified  -  verify before citing in public copy.

---

*End of digest. Sources: `Beexly/Sports/docs/research/2026-09-21/`  -  sweep-2026-09-21.md,
x-sweep-evening-2026-09-21.md, x-author-methodology-pass-2026-09-21.md,
backend-gold-exhaustive-2026-09-21.md, nfl-protocols/injury-concussion-protocol.md,
notes/{benlinsey,cfb_data,matt_barlowe,nextgenstats,thehonestnfl}.md,
wiring/{IMPLEMENTED,WIRING-PLAN}.md, drive-deep/*.md. Overlap boundaries honored for report.md,
arxiv-sports-index.md, ngs-digest.md, learnings.md.*
